name: kinetis/persistence
description: Request-scoped SQL transaction safety net, runtime-matched native DB drivers (mysqli async, ext-pgsql async, PDO), and the connection factory for Kinetis — MySQL and Postgres.

suggest.ext-mysqli: Needed by the native MySQL driver (Kinetis\Persistence\Driver\MysqliAsyncClient) — the default under FrankenPHP worker mode via DB_DRIVER=auto.
suggest.ext-pgsql: Needed by the native Postgres driver (Kinetis\Persistence\Driver\PgsqlAsyncClient) — the default under FrankenPHP worker mode via DB_DRIVER=auto.
suggest.ext-pdo_mysql: Needed by the PDO MySQL driver (Kinetis\Persistence\Driver\PdoMysqlClient) — the default under PHP-FPM via DB_DRIVER=auto.
suggest.ext-pdo_pgsql: Needed by the PDO Postgres driver (Kinetis\Persistence\Driver\PdoPgsqlClient) — the default under PHP-FPM via DB_DRIVER=auto.
